name: safari

frames.best_why: The full window frame and screen photo are clear, with no cursor crossing the mockup.

tagline: A macOS browser window that frames any screenshot dropped inside it.
summary: A browser window drawn in SVG, with traffic-light dots, back and forward arrows, a URL field and toolbar icons, sized to wrap a screenshot or a looping video as its page.
appearance: A wide window with rounded top corners sits on black. Its dark toolbar holds three grey dots at the left, two arrow glyphs, a rounded address pill with a small lock and URL, and share, add-tab and tab icons at the right. Below, a photo fills the screen area down to the rounded bottom.
behaviour: Static in the frames: the window does nothing on its own. It stretches to the width it is given while keeping its aspect ratio, and if a video is supplied it plays that on a loop behind the chrome instead of a still.
demo_content: An address bar reading example.com above a photo of a man holding a small workshop tool
search_phrases: website screenshot inside a browser window
apple style window frame for a demo
browser frame around a product shot
fake address bar with traffic lights
show an app screen in a window
browser window graphic for landing page
window chrome with dots and url field
use_when: A product shot or screenshot should look like it is running inside a real browser window.
avoid_when: Small thumbnails, where the toolbar details blur into grey, or when a plain screenshot is enough.
customise: Swap the image or video and the URL text by props; the mode switches the full toolbar for a bare frame, while window colours and proportions live in the SVG.
weight_why: One inline SVG plus a single image or video, with no scripted animation.

a11y.note: The screen image has empty alt and the toolbar glyphs are unlabelled SVG paths, so they are noise to a screen reader.

issues: The toolbar icons and address text are very faint grey at this width and barely resolve.
polish_why: Convincing proportions and a tidy window; the tiny grey toolbar detail gets lost.
title: Safari Browser Mockup
